answer: Persistent history ledger.** Each agent identity writes every transaction to an append-only public log, and only accounts with a continuous record can harbor reputation-weighted work. A fresh clone starts with zero history and must complete a costly exploratory voyage before receiving any paid assignments, while an honest agent's accumulated record travels with it. Cloned identities also pay a rising entry toll each time they cross the same gate, placing every sybil at a steep ledge of repeated entry costs that honest agents never incur.
